usageNotes: Permanently removes a scheduled vzdump backup job definition from the cluster configuration. Requires the `Sys.Modify` privilege at the root path (`/`). This operation is synchronous and returns null — the job entry is removed immediately with no undo; any VMs or CTs that were covered by this schedule will no longer be backed up automatically.

examples.summary: Delete a daily backup job by its job ID

destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the backup job definition; scheduled backups for all covered guests will cease immediately and the configuration cannot be recovered.
tips: Retrieve the job ID first via GET /cluster/backup (list_cluster_backup) — the ID is not human-assigned and looks like a UUID-style token.
Deleting the job does NOT delete any existing backup archives already written to storage; those must be removed separately.
This call returns null on success with no confirmation step — verify the correct ID before issuing the request.
API tokens must have the `Sys.Modify` privilege granted at `/`; a token scoped only to a guest path will be denied.
